environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No CloudFront distribution or API Gateway in front. No VPC restrictions. The function has an execution role with codebuild:StartBuild and codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution permissions. WebSocket connections are accepted from any origin, and the permissive token validation allows any 8+ character string.
